The provided text aligns closely with the standard themes of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting ("Neo-Tokyo"), a stark contrast between high technology and low life, and the central role of hackers and megacorporations. The protagonist, Zara, embodies the archetypal cybernetic operative, and the narrative emphasizes the commodification of information and the blurring of lines between reality and virtual space, which are hallmark elements of cyberpunk literature.
